description: Connects to a host and reports its TLS certificate: issuer, subject, validity dates, days remaining, whether the chain is trusted and the name matches, and the protocol and cipher in use.

host.description: Host name, or a URL from which the host is taken.

name: inspect_ssl_certificate

chain.description: Every certificate the server sent, in the same shape.

chain_error.description: Verification error when the chain fails.

days_remaining.description: Days until expiry, negative when expired.

not_yet_valid.description: Whether the certificate is not yet valid.

trusted_chain.description: Whether the chain verifies against the CA store.

valid.description: True when the chain is trusted, the name matches and the certificate is within its dates.

title: Inspect an SSL certificate
